title: aaas.result.voted.v1
description: Published by outbox-relay (Debezium) from the outbox of saga-orchestrator once the Peano result is computed and, from P4.5, confirmed by the consensus majority. Consumed by ledger, which records it.

producer.description: The only service allowed to publish this event (contracts/events/topics.psv).

taskId.description: Addition task the event belongs to; never null for this event.

payload.description: The operands and the agreed result of the addition.

result.description: Sum computed by Peano arithmetic (b successor calls starting from a) and, from P4.5, equal to the result of the consensus majority.
